name: site_truth_v0
purpose: Ground truth for scoring site understanding (lanes, divided, shoulder, one-way, parking, sidewalk, work location, width). Not a source for rules.
rules: A null value means no truth for that field; it is not scored.
Only values with confidence high or medium-high go into the CSV used by the accuracy report.
expected_tool_behavior says what the tool should do on an edge case; the truth value is separate from it.
Never edit a value silently. Change it by creating a new version and recording why.

confidence_levels.high: two independent readings agree, or an explicit symbol or note on the drawing
confidence_levels.medium-high: one clear reading plus a consistent second hint
confidence_levels.medium: one reading with a known weakness; excluded from the CSV until verified
